name: Micah Bergman
source:
Micah is a drama club student at North Shore High who meets the protagonist on her first day. She is unsure how she feels about him.

[Spoiler]He found out his girlfriend whom he was dating for 3 years was cheating on him at Glen Coco's party which lead to the relationship ending. Since then, he developed a cynical view on love and wrote a play reflecting his feelings called "The Love Delusion".[/spoiler]
